title: Sales Development Representative - Remote
description:
Title: Sales Development Representative

Function: Sales

Reports to: Director, Sales Development

Location: Australia - Remote

Position Summary:

As a Sales Development Representative (SDR), you will be responsible for developing demand for the company's products and solutions. In this role, you will establish relationships with prospective customers to create a viable sales pipeline through marketing lead generation campaigns and direct outreach. You will play an integral part in conveying the value of the platform to potential clients, directly impacting the company's future success. Additionally, this role offers opportunities for growth and professional development both within and beyond the department.

Key Responsibilities:

Lead Qualification: Identify, engage, and qualify leads from various marketing channels (e.g., website, conferences, etc.) and ensure they align with the company’s solutions.

  • Conduct direct outreach to engage new leads while prospecting into a technical audience, applying a deep understanding of the B2B sales cycle, and effectively handling objections.
  • Analyze lead generation trends and optimize outreach efforts based on feedback and performance metrics.
  • Utilize phone, email, and social selling techniques to connect with key decision-makers, delivering compelling value propositions tailored to their needs.

Sales & Marketing Collaboration: Serve as a liaison between marketing and sales, actively engaging in marketing campaigns, analyzing trends, and collaborating with Account Executives to nurture key prospects and facilitate a seamless transition from prospecting to closing.

Quota Achievement: Engage new leads through direct outreach while developing a broader understanding of the B2B sales cycle, including prospecting into a technical audience and handling objections. Required to consistently meet or exceed assigned quotas for Booked Meetings and Sales Accepted Leads (SALs) contributing to overall revenue growth.

Pipeline & Performance Tracking: Consistently track and report key sales development metrics, including conversion rates, meeting attendance, and engagement trends.

Tools & Technology Usage: Use a variety of sales tools (SalesForce, etc.) to maintain and record detailed and accurate records of customer interactions and pipeline.

Gain experience in a fast-paced culture with corporate exposure while contributing to marketing strategies and developing professionally. Proactively seeks knowledge and stays informed about industry trends and innovations.

Skills & Experience Needed:

  • Bachelor's Degree Required
  • Minimum 1+ years of proven sales development experience (exceeding quota) or customer-facing role engaging prospects while demonstrating strong communication, adaptability, and professionalism.
  • Minimum 1+ years working within a CRM system (Salesforce experience preferred).
  • Must be an Australian Citizen or Permanent Resident currently based in Australia and willing to continue to work in Australia remotely
  • Develop and deliver compelling outreach through strong communication skills, while confidently speaking in front of an audience and handling objections effectively.
  • Strong organizational and time management abilities, with a disciplined approach to prospecting and follow-ups.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment while maintaining a high level of self-motivation and discipline.
  • Comfortable speaking in front of an audience, whether in team meetings, client presentations, or sales pitches.
  • Demonstrate a growth mindset, adaptability, and a commitment to continuous learning, with a willingness to learn and be coached.

Competencies:

Accountability

Adaptability

Applied Learning

Business Acumen

Collaboration

Customer Focus

Dealing w/Ambiguity

Decision Making

Driving for Results

Initiating Action

Planning and Organizing

Technical/Professional Knowledge/Skills

About the Company:

Boards set the standard for what organizations can achieve. At OnBoard, our board management software helps boards function at a higher level so every organization can make a bigger difference in the world.

Launched in 2011, today, OnBoard serves as the board intelligence platform for more than 5,000 organizations and their 12,000 boards and committees in 60 countries worldwide. With customers in higher education, nonprofit, healthcare systems, government, and enterprise business, OnBoard is the leading board management provider.

OnBoard has grown from a class project at Purdue University in West Lafayette, Indiana in 2003 into the world’s leading board management software platform today. Backed by JMI Equity and the acquisitions of eScribe and Govenda, OnBoard is positioned to become the industry leader in Board Management and Meeting Solutions for private and public sector entities.

This person will support the customer relationship with a focus on improving customer experience, account retention and sales growth. This position requires organizational, project management, interpersonal and computer/data management skills as well as independent judgment to anticipate and solve problems to maintain smooth and professional client service delivery experience. The Client Service Delivery Coordinator interacts and serves as a point of contact with cross-functional leadership members. All aspects of this position impact revenue, retention and overall service.

Location: Remote (West Coast candidates only; must be based in the Pacific or Mountain Time Zones.)

JOB DUTIES and RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Adheres to service level goals, individual and team performance goals, quality assurance targets and productivity levels.
  • Supports RenewableWorks business including knowledge of partners that are critical to customer success.
  • Partners with operations and sales teams after identifying specific customer service issues and trends; implements appropriate action plans to address root cause.
  • Ensures excellent customer and field communication for program success.
  • Implements suggested system and workflow improvements to enhance the team's efficiency and relies on experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals and tasks focused on speed to delivery service.
  • Develops relationships to become the point of contact with key representatives and enhance proactive communication and follow through on all transactions.

CORE KNOWLEDGE and SKILLS

  • Microsoft Office products, including Outlook, Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to work independently, organize and prioritize workload to meet deadlines, utilize a wide degree of creativity and latitude to accomplish goals, understand business implications of decisions, and complete multiple tasks/ projects with minimal supervision in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong verbal and written communication, the ability to communicate effectively and conducts meetings. Must be able to interact well at all levels of the organization.
  • Ability to drive team efficiency and productivity while fostering a positive, motivational work environment that supports collaboration and team work.
  • Strong problem solving, attention to detail, and analytical ability. Ability to analyze and consider potential conclusions as it relates to historical data and current events to anticipate business needs and implement plans accordingly.
  • Works effectively and proficiently with customers, vendors and management team to build relationships and investigate and resolve issues and challenges.
  • Strong ability to work in multiple platforms efficiently and accurately.
  • Strong customer and team interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to influence others.
  • Conducts business with integrity, high moral standards, and ethical behavior.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • High school diploma, GED or international equivalent required.
  • At least 1 year required experience supporting customer inquiries, product fulfillment and services, and is accountable for problem resolution success and a focus on retention.
  • At least 1 year industry-specific experience in the Professional Services/Staffing/Client Service Delivery field is preferred.

WORK ENVIRONMENT and PHYSICAL DEMANDS

  • Employee is frequently required to stand, walk, sit, talk, and/or hear for long periods of time. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 10 pounds, occasionally lift and/or move 25 pounds.
  • This is a remote/virtual role; work from home.

Salary Range: $19.00 - $21.50 per hour, depending on experience and geographic location.

Please note that actual compensation offered may vary based on local pay requirements, and will meet or exceed state-specific minimum wage or salary thresholds.

Benefits and Well-Being:

We offer a competitive benefits package, including 6 paid holidays, 1 paid floating holiday and up to 15 days of Paid Time Off per year, Medical/Dental/Vision insurance, Company-matching 401(k) and Employee Stock Purchase Program, in addition to other programs and perks. More details about our benefits can be found here.

We consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with applicable law.

You must be work authorized in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future. The Company cannot offer employment to F-1 (student) visa holders who require employer sponsorship in the future or cannot work now on a full-time basis.

TrueBlue, Inc. and its brands welcome and encourage applications from candidates with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in the application or interview process. If you require disability-related accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact your Recruiter directly, Employee Relations at , or 1-800-610-8920. TrueBlue, Inc. and its brands will consult with all applicants who request disability-related accommodation during the application or interview process to ensure that the accommodation provided takes into account the applicant’s individual accessibility needs.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets â including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review â as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.

The Opportunity ð

As Corporate Counsel, Commercial, you will be the legal partner behind Carrotâs customer and vendor contracts. Day to day, you will negotiate, draft, and review a high volume of commercial agreements, including master services agreements, service level agreements, professional services agreements, and NDAs. You will partner closely with Sales and other business teams to resolve redlines and customer questions quickly, manage most matters from start to finish, and escalate high-risk issues when the moment calls for it.

  • Manage a high volume of contracts at all times while protecting quality and turnaround speed.
  • Support privacy and data protection terms in commercial agreements, including HIPAA Business Associate Agreements and Data Protection Agreements.
  • Work across a complex, global matrix of collaborators to support Carrotâs growth.
  • Use contract lifecycle management and AI tools to improve the efficiency of legal research, drafting, and contract workflows.

Â 

What Success Looks Like Â ð

In your first 12â18 months, you will have:

  • Improved contract workflows by making full use of Ironclad and AI-enabled tools.




About You â¨

You likely have:

  • A J.D. and membership in at least one U.S. state bar.
  • 3+ years of legal experience, in-house and/or at a law firm, ideally with in-house transactional experience at a health plan or startup.
  • A strong grasp of contracting concepts and solid experience drafting, negotiating, and interpreting commercial and vendor agreements such as MSAs, SLAs, professional services agreements, and NDAs.
  • Experience counseling a sales organization.
  • The ability to analyze and advise on legal and regulatory risk, with creative solutions that support growth.
  • Flexibility, a willingness to work on a broad variety of legal matters, and comfort with ambiguity.
  • A record of strategic thinking and of working across a complex matrix of global collaborators, pairing strong legal analysis with practical business recommendations.

Â 

Nice to Have â­

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

  • Experience drafting and negotiating commercial contracts with global companies.
  • Experience with complex multi-party commercial agreements and vendor agreement review.
  • Hands-on experience with contract lifecycle management software, especially Ironclad.
  • Experience using AI tools.
  • Knowledge of privacy laws including HIPAA, CCPA, and GDPR in the context of BAAs and DPAs.
  • Interest in fertility and reproductive health policy, and how it differs by country and culture.
  • Knowledge of the employee benefits, healthcare, and/or pharmaceutical industries.

Â 

Why This Role Matters ð§¡

Carrotâs contracts are how our mission reaches people. Every agreement with an employer, health plan, or health system shapes how well members around the world can access fertility and family-building care. In this role, you help Carrot say yes to growth in ways that protect the company, our customers, and the members we serve.

Because you will own most matters from beginning to end, your judgment directly affects deal velocity, customer trust, and revenue. You will be a visible, trusted partner to Sales and the broader business while helping a rapidly growing global company scale its commercial legal function.



Interview Process ð¤

We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team.

For this role, candidates can expect:

  1. Recruiter Screen â 30 minutes
  2. Hiring Manager Interview â 30â45 minutes
  3. Cross-Functional Panel Interviews â 45 minutes
  4. Executive Leadership Conversation â 30 minutes

Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role.

Â 

Why Candidates Join Carrot ð

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

Â 

Â 

Compensationð°

Our benefits include comprehensive health and wellness coverage, retirement savings plans, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. This role is:

Base + equity roles:
Compensation for this role is structured as base salary plus equity, giving you ownership in Carrot's long-term growth. This role does not include an annual bonus or variable compensation.

  • Base Salary Range:Â  $140,000-$160,000
  • Geo-Tier Adjustment: ForÂ highly experienced candidates within 50 miles of San Francisco, NYC, or Seattle.

Actual compensation may vary from the posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience.

A Note on AI

At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. description:
Our Mission

We believe in the power of technology to improve access to healthcare and weâre building the rails that make this a reality. We work fast and with quality because we provide business-critical, healthcare-critical software that clinicians and patients need for a better healthcare system. Weâre customer-obsessed, operate with lightning-fast processes and responses, and always share our product roadmap publicly-Â  so customers can see what weâre building, and remain relentlessly focused on how care gets delivered.

Healthie is backed by leading investors, and while we've $42M raised to date, more importantly, we operate with fiscal responsibility and have been profitable for more than half of our time as a company. About the role

Weâre hiring a Customer Success Manager to join our Private Practice Enablement team and help customers get the most out of Healthie throughout their entire journey with us. Youâll work with private practices and growing healthcare organizationsâsome brand new to Healthie, others who have been with us for years.

This is a highly customer-facing role centered around understanding how practices operate and helping them use Healthie to accomplish their goals. Youâll build relationships with healthcare executives, practice managers, providers, and clinical champions, becoming a trusted resource as their workflows, teams, and needs evolve.

Our ideal hire is curious, resourceful, and a natural educator. You enjoy learning how different healthcare organizations work, can turn complex questions into clear next steps, and are excited to develop the product expertise needed to help customers use Healthie successfully.

About the work

  • Youâll spend much of your day connecting directly with customers through live 1:1 calls and email, helping with everything from initial setup and training to workflow optimization, feature adoption, and new needs that emerge as their practices grow.

  • Youâll manage multiple customer conversations and priorities at once, adapting your communication and approach to different practices, personalities, and challenges.
  • Youâll collaborate with Support, Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing, sharing what youâre learning from customers and helping improve our product, resources, processes, and overall customer experience.


Details, details

  • This is a full-time, remote position and U.S. work authorization is required.
  • This job is Monday-Friday, 9am-5pm PST.Â 
  • Weâre seeking fluent English speakers/writers.
  • The salary range is $93,000 - $102,500

About you

Youâve done this kind of work before. Weâre looking for someone with 3â5 years of experience in Customer Success or similar customer-facing role. And it is a requirement that you've worked at a software company. Bonus points if youâve worked in healthcare technology, or have experience working with private practices or growing healthcare organizations.

  • Youâre comfortable independently leading customer conversations and building relationships with everyone from individual providers to practice managers and healthcare leaders. You ask thoughtful questions, listen closely, and know how to adapt your approach to the person in front of you.
  • Youâre a natural educator and an excellent communicator. You can take complicated products, workflows, and questions and turn them into clear, practical next steps. We value good writers.
  • Youâre curious about how customers work. You want to understand what someone is actually trying to accomplish before recommending a solution, and you enjoy learning the different ways healthcare organizations operate and deliver care.
  • Youâre a strong problem-solver with good judgment. When there isnât an obvious answer, youâre comfortable researching, testing different approaches, and using the resources around you to figure out the best path forward.
  • Youâre organized and self-directed. You can manage customer calls, emails, follow-ups, and projects simultaneously, take ownership of whatâs in front of you, and recognize when something needs another perspective or team.
  • Youâre good at navigating challenging conversations. You can set expectations, explain limitations, and provide thoughtful guidance even when the answer isnât exactly what a customer hoped to hear.
  • You have plenty of tech skills, and you're confident working across a variety of tools and apps, and can troubleshoot everyday issues on your ownâthings like browser quirks, connectivity problems, login hiccups, and mobile device settings.
  • Youâre a collaborative teammate and strong customer advocate. You share what youâre learning, give helpful and direct feedback, and bring patterns from customer conversations back to the broader team so we can continue improving how we support our customers and build Healthie.

How to applyÂ 

Please submit a PDF cover letter and introduce yourself. Include:

  • Tell us who you are and why you want this job at Healthie.
  • Where are you based and what time zone are you in?
  • Why do you want to work in Customer Success?

In your cover letter, answer these real-world customer scenarios. Reply to the customer directly like you would if you worked on our Private Practice team. Also tell us how youâd approach the conversation, and explain your thinking for each reply.Â 

  • A customer recently signed up for Healthie and is excited to get started. They want to go live as soon as possible and have an upcoming appointment with a client. They need help manually adding the client to Healthie and sending them an invitation to access the platform.

  • A customer who has been using Healthie for several years reaches out because their practice has grown and their current workflow is no longer working well for their team. They have a specific idea for how theyâd like to solve the problem, but you arenât sure whether Healthie can support exactly what theyâre asking for.Â 

Interview Process

  • Quick chat with our Talent team (15 minutes)
  • Interview with Talita, Private Practice Team Lead (30 minutes)
  • Interview with Justin, VP of Customer Support (30 minutes)
  • Live demo with Talita and Jen (30 minutes)
    • Youâll be asked to give us a brief product demo. Youâll share your screen and show us how to add a client and schedule an appointment.Â 
  • Final session with Talita and Justin (30 minutes)

Healthie is subject to HIPAA and other security and privacy frameworks, and this job entails training and conformance to expectations regarding security and compliance.

Healthie participates in e-verify.

title: Compliance Officer/MLRO
description:
About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the worldâs leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 â connecting users to the future of digital finance.
Â 
Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
Â 
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

Role Purpose

Lead the establishment and ongoing oversight of the Pakistan entityâs independent Compliance function and Anti-Money Laundering, Counter-Terrorist Financing and Counter-Proliferation Financing (AML/CFT/CPF) framework.
During the pre-licensing phase, the role holder will lead Compliance-owned licensing deliverables, develop the local control framework and assess operational readiness. Following licensing, the role holder will discharge the entityâs CO/MLRO responsibilities, advise the Board and senior management, and maintain effective engagement with PVARA, the Financial Monitoring Unit (FMU) and other relevant authorities.
The role combines CO and MLRO responsibilities, subject to applicable regulatory requirements and any required regulatory acceptance or approval. The suitability of the combined arrangement will be reviewed periodically, considering independence, conflicts, capacity, resources and the entityâs nature, scale and complexity.
Â 

Key Responsibilities

  1. Licensing and Operational Readiness
  • Lead Compliance-owned components of the PVARA licensing application and coordinate relevant inputs from Legal, Business, Risk, Finance, Operations and Technology.
  • Develop and maintain a regulatory obligations register, licensing deliverables tracker and local implementation roadmap.
  • Assess gaps between group policies, systems and controls and applicable Pakistan requirements; oversee localisation and track remediation.
  • Establish local Compliance and AML/CFT/CPF policies, governance arrangements, escalation procedures and regulatory reporting processes.
  • Define local control requirements for customer onboarding, transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, Travel Rule compliance and suspicious transaction reporting.
  • Assess the suitability and readiness of local, group-provided and outsourced controls, including relevant pre-launch testing.
  • Provide a documented Compliance and AML readiness assessment to the appropriate governance forum, escalating unresolved material gaps before launch.
Â 
  1. Compliance Oversight
  • Establish, administer and maintain a documented, risk-based Compliance Management System (CMS) proportionate to the entityâs activities and risk profile.
  • Advise the Board, relevant committees and senior management on applicable legal and regulatory requirements, licence conditions and regulatory developments.
  • Develop and execute a risk-based Compliance Monitoring and Testing Plan; document findings, agree remediation ownership and deadlines with accountable functions, independently validate closure, and escalate overdue or inadequate remediation.
  • Oversee compliance with applicable conduct, customer protection, complaints-handling, client-asset and market-integrity requirements, according to the entityâs licensed activities.
  • Review proposed products, services and material business changes from a local compliance perspective, identifying requirements, restrictions and necessary controls.
  • Ensure material non-compliance is investigated, promptly escalated and remediated, and notified to PVARA where required.
  • Maintain regulatory submission and commitment trackers, overseeing timely and accurate Compliance-owned responses and escalating dependency risks.
  • Act as the primary Compliance liaison with PVARA for supervisory engagement, inspections and information requests.
  • Develop and oversee Compliance training for employees, senior management and relevant key individuals.
Â 
  1. AML/CFT/CPF and Financial Crime
  • Establish, implement and maintain the entityâs AML/CFT/CPF framework, aligned with applicable Pakistan legislation, regulatory requirements and relevant directions or guidance.
  • Lead the enterprise-wide financial crime risk assessment and oversee risk-based mitigation measures.
  • Oversee customer due diligence, beneficial ownership identification, customer risk assessment, enhanced due diligence and ongoing monitoring.
  • Oversee transaction monitoring, sanctions screening and targeted financial sanctions controls, including escalation and action on relevant alerts.
  • Oversee virtual asset-specific controls, including blockchain analytics, risks associated with unhosted wallets and Travel Rule compliance where applicable.
  • Receive and assess internal suspicious activity referrals, determine whether external reporting is required, and submit suspicious transaction reports to the FMU within applicable deadlines.
  • Exercise independent judgement on suspicious transaction reporting without requiring business approval, while maintaining confidentiality and preventing tipping-off.
  • Manage the entityâs FMU/goAML registration, access arrangements and reporting processes, as applicable.
  • Ensure required customer, transaction and investigation records are retained for applicable periods and remain accessible and retrievable.
  • Liaise with the FMU and other competent authorities on financial crime matters and oversee relevant information requests.
  • Oversee AML/CFT/CPF training and awareness, tailored to employeesâ responsibilities and exposure to risk.
Â 
  1. Governance, Reporting and Control Assurance
  • Provide periodic reports to the Board or designated committee on Compliance and AML/CFT/CPF effectiveness, material risks, incidents, findings and remediation progress.
  • Escalate urgent or material matters promptly rather than waiting for scheduled reporting.
  • Attend relevant Board and committee meetings and provide independent advice and challenge.
  • Assess and oversee group-provided and outsourced Compliance/AML services, including local regulatory suitability, service standards, data access, management information and escalation arrangements.
  • Oversee delegated Compliance and AML/CFT/CPF activities and remain accountable for discharging the CO/MLRO responsibilities, without displacing the responsibilities of the entity, Board, senior management or operational control owners.
  • Coordinate with Risk and Internal Audit, while preserving the distinction between Compliance oversight and independent audit assurance.
  • Support periodic review of the role holderâs continuing fitness, propriety and suitability, including the required review of the MLRO appointment.
  • Maintain effective handover and suitably qualified cover arrangements for absences, consistent with applicable regulatory requirements.
Â 

Qualifications and Experience

Essential
  • A degree in law, finance, business or a related discipline, or an equivalent relevant professional qualification.
  • At least eight yearsâ relevant Compliance and/or AML/CFT experience in financial services, including at least three years in a senior Compliance, MLRO or equivalent leadership role.
  • Strong knowledge of Pakistanâs financial regulatory and AML/CFT framework, including the Virtual Assets Act, applicable PVARA regulations, the Anti-Money Laundering Act and FMU reporting requirements.
  • Demonstrable understanding of virtual asset business models and their financial crime, conduct and operational risks.
  • Practical experience with customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, investigations and suspicious transaction reporting.
  • Experience developing risk assessments, policies, monitoring programmes and Board-level reporting.
  • Ability to translate regulatory requirements into workable business, operational and technology controls.
  • Be resident in Pakistan by the date of the formal CO/MLRO appointment and maintain residency as required under applicable regulations.
  • Fluency in English and Urdu.
Â 
Desirable
  • Professional certification such as CAMS, an ICA qualification or an equivalent Compliance/AML credential.
  • Experience in virtual assets, exchanges, fintech or digital financial services.
  • Experience supporting a regulatory licence application or establishing a local Compliance function.
  • Experience engaging with PVARA, FMU, SECP, SBP or other relevant Pakistani authorities.
  • Familiarity with blockchain analytics tools and Travel Rule solutions.
  • Experience overseeing centralised group services and outsourced control arrangements.
Â 
Key Competencies
  • Independence, integrity and sound judgement.
  • Confidence to challenge senior management constructively.
  • Clear communication with regulators, the Board and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong analytical, investigative and problem-solving skills.
  • Effective prioritisation in a developing regulatory environment.
  • Ability to build a local control framework while working within a global organisation.
Â 
Authority and Independence
  • Direct access to the local Board or designated committee, including the ability to escalate without prior management clearance.
  • Timely and unrestricted access to relevant records, systems, personnel and management information necessary to discharge the role, subject to applicable confidentiality and data-handling requirements.
  • Adequate resources and suitably qualified support proportionate to the entityâs activities and risk profile.
  • No client-facing, sales or other responsibilities that compromise independence, create material conflicts or impair CO/MLRO duties.
  • Remuneration arrangements that do not link the role holderâs performance to sales or revenue targets.
  • Group reporting arrangements that do not restrict local regulatory accountability, Board access or independent MLRO decision-making.
  • Board oversight of appointment, replacement and removal, with regulatory approvals or notifications completed as applicable.
Â 
Regulatory Appointment Conditions
The role holder must satisfy applicable fitness and propriety, residency, employment, competence and regulatory appointment requirements at appointment and on an ongoing basis. Any required PVARA approval, acceptance or notification must be completed in accordance with the applicable framework.

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment.Â 
Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.

- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

Wir suchen einen technischen Mitarbeiter im After Sales Support in Vollzeit (40h/Woche)

Wir bei Offgridtec beschäftigen uns mit Photovoltaik, Stromspeichern, Wechselrichtern, Solartechnik und autarker Energieversorgung. Für unseren After Sales Support suchen wir Verstärkung.

Dabei ist uns nicht entscheidend, ob du in unserer Nähe wohnst:
Nach einer entsprechenden Einarbeitung kann die Stelle zu 100 % remote ausgeübt werden.

Deine Aufgaben

Du unterstützt unsere Kunden bei technischen Fragen rund um unsere Produkte und Systeme – sowohl vor dem Kauf bei der Auswahl der passenden Lösung als auch danach bei Einrichtung, Anwendung und Fehlerbehebung.

  • Kundensysteme per Remotezugriff prüfen, konfigurieren und bei der Einrichtung unterstützen

  • Fälle sauber in unseren Systemen dokumentieren

  • eng mit Kundenservice, Verkauf und Retourenabteilung zusammenarbeiten

  • technische Angebote passend zum Bedarf unserer Kunden erstellen

Das solltest du mitbringen:

Wichtig ist uns vor allem dein technisches Verständnis.

Ideal ist Erfahrung in einem oder mehreren dieser Bereiche:

  • Photovoltaik und Solartechnik

  • Batteriespeicher und Wechselrichter

  • 12-/24-/48-V-Systeme

  • Wohnmobil-, Camper- oder Marine-Elektrik

  • Elektrotechnik oder Elektronik

  • technische Kundenbetreuung

  • generelles Interesse an neuen technischen Lösungen

Du musst nicht jedes unserer Produkte bereits kennen. Viel wichtiger ist, dass du technische Zusammenhänge verstehst, strukturiert nach Fehlerursachen suchen kannst und gerne mit Kunden arbeitest.

Außerdem solltest du:

  • sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift beherrschen

  • freundlich, geduldig und lösungsorientiert kommunizieren

  • selbstständig und zuverlässig arbeiten

  • dich schnell in neue Produkte und Systeme einarbeiten können

  • auch in schwierigeren Kundensituationen ruhig und professionell bleiben

Das bieten wir dir:

  • 100 % Remote-Arbeit nach entsprechender Einarbeitung möglich

  • einen Arbeitsplatz in einem spannenden Wachstumsmarkt rund um erneuerbare und unabhängige Energieversorgung

  • strukturierte Einarbeitung in unsere Produkte und Abläufe

  • modernes digitales Arbeitsumfeld inklusive der Arbeit mit KI-gestützten Tools und Agenten

  • kurze Wege und direkte Ansprechpartner

  • Mitarbeiterrabatte für den Eigenbedarf

  • umfangreiche Corporate Benefits

  • Firmenfahrrad

  • Firmenhandy

  • Sommerfest und Weihnachtsfeier

Hinzu kommt unser Benefit-System. Nach sechs Monaten sind unter anderem 50 € monatliche Primecard, 115 € Essensschecks, 156 € Erholungsbeihilfe pro Jahr, 60 € Geburtstagsbonus sowie ein Arbeitgeberbeitrag zur OffgridtecRente (betriebliche Altersvorsorge) vorgesehen.

Nach zwölf Monaten kommt OffgridtecGesundheit mit bis zu 600 Euro jährlichem Gesundheitsbudget (private Krankenzusatzversicherung) hinzu.

Klingt interessant?

Dann schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf und erzähl uns kurz, mit welchen technischen Produkten oder Systemen du bisher gearbeitet hast.

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Deine Einarbeitung startet im Optimalfall bei uns vor Ort in Eggenfelden, damit du dein Team und unsere Produkte persönlich kennenlernst. Anschließend kannst du deine Tätigkeit zu 100 % remote ausüben. Die Kosten für Anreise und Unterkunft während der vereinbarten Einarbeitung übernehmen wir.

In den ersten Wochen arbeitest du dich intensiv in unser Produktsortiment und unsere Support-Prozesse ein. Dabei lernst du insbesondere unsere Lösungen aus den Bereichen Photovoltaik, Batteriespeicher, Wechselrichter und autarke Energieversorgung kennen.

Schritt für Schritt übernimmst du eigene Kundenanfragen und bearbeitest technische Anliegen zunehmend selbstständig und vollständig. Gemeinsam mit deinem Team sorgst du dafür, dass unsere Kunden schnell kompetente und praktische Lösungen erhalten.

title: Werkstudent Founders Associate
description:
Die AdWise Media GmbH ist ein wachsendes Unternehmen im Bereich Retail Media. Wir bringen Unternehmen mit attraktiven Werbeflächen direkt am Point of Sale zusammen und arbeiten dabei mit zahlreichen Standorten des deutschen Lebensmitteleinzelhandels zusammen.

Für unser Team in Bonn suchen wir einen Werkstudenten Founders Associate (m/w/d), der direkt mit der Geschäftsführung zusammenarbeitet und uns bei strategischen sowie operativen Themen unterstützt.

Bei uns bekommst du keine klassische Werkstudentenrolle, in der du lediglich Aufgaben abarbeitest. Du erhältst Einblicke in nahezu alle Unternehmensbereiche, übernimmst eigene Projekte und kannst deine Ideen direkt einbringen und umsetzen.

Ein besonderer Schwerpunkt liegt dabei auf KI und Automatisierung: Wir wollen bestehende Prozesse kontinuierlich hinterfragen und herausfinden, wie wir mit AI, Automatisierungen und modernen Tools noch effizienter arbeiten können.

Aufgaben

Als Founders Associate arbeitest du direkt mit den Gründern und der Geschäftsführung zusammen. Deine Aufgaben sind entsprechend vielseitig und richten sich nach den aktuellen Herausforderungen und Prioritäten des Unternehmens.

  • Unterstützung der Gründer bei strategischen und operativen Themen

  • Eigenständige Übernahme und Umsetzung verschiedener Projekte

  • Recherche und Aufbereitung von Informationen als Grundlage für unternehmerische Entscheidungen

  • Erstellung von Analysen, Präsentationen, Reports und Entscheidungsvorlagen

  • Analyse von Unternehmenskennzahlen und Ableitung konkreter Handlungsempfehlungen

  • Unterstützung bei Projekten in den Bereichen Vertrieb, Operations, Marketing und Business Development

  • Analyse und Weiterentwicklung bestehender interner Prozesse

  • Koordination und Nachhalten wichtiger Projekte und Aufgaben

  • Recherche zu neuen Geschäftsmöglichkeiten, Märkten, Tools und Technologien

  • Unterstützung bei kurzfristig auftretenden operativen Herausforderungen

  • Einsatz von KI- und Automatisierungstools, wenn sich Prozesse oder Aufgaben dadurch sinnvoll effizienter gestalten lassen

Du bekommst dabei nicht für jede Aufgabe eine fertige Anleitung. Wir suchen jemanden, der sich selbstständig in neue Themen einarbeitet, Probleme strukturiert und eigene Lösungsvorschläge entwickelt.

Qualifikation

Für uns ist weniger entscheidend, welchen Studiengang du belegst. Viel wichtiger ist, wie du denkst und arbeitest.

  • Du bist aktuell an einer Hochschule oder Universität eingeschrieben

  • Du interessierst dich für Unternehmertum, Unternehmensaufbau und wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge

  • Du hast eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe und kannst dich eigenständig in neue Themen einarbeiten

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und lösungsorientiert

  • Du hast einen hohen eigenen Qualitätsanspruch und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Aufgaben

  • Du bist analytisch stark und kannst Informationen schnell erfassen und verständlich aufbereiten

  • Du bist digital affin und findest dich schnell in neuen Tools und Systemen zurecht

  • Du hast idealerweise bereits Erfahrung im Umgang mit KI-Tools wie ChatGPT, Claude oder vergleichbaren Anwendungen

  • Du verstehst KI als Werkzeug und kannst einschätzen, wann sich Aufgaben durch KI oder Automatisierungen effizienter lösen lassen

  • Gute Kenntnisse in Excel bzw. Google Sheets sind von Vorteil

  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Vorkenntnisse mit Automatisierungstools wie Make oder n8n sind ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Benefits

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern und der Geschäftsführung

  • Einblicke in nahezu alle relevanten Bereiche eines wachsenden Unternehmens

  • Eigene Projekte und echte Verantwortung von Anfang an

  • Sehr steile Lernkurve und unmittelbarer Einblick in unternehmerische Entscheidungen

  • Viel Freiraum für eigene Ideen und Verbesserungsvorschläge

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege und schnelle Umsetzung

  • Praktische Erfahrung in Strategie, Operations, Vertrieb und Business Development

  • Arbeit mit modernen digitalen Tools und KI-Anwendungen

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, die sich mit deinem Studium vereinbaren lassen

  • Modernes Arbeitsumfeld in unserem Büro in Bonn oder flexibel von Zuhause

  • Möglichkeit, deine Rolle und Verantwortung mit dem Unternehmen weiterzuentwickeln

Wir suchen keinen Werkstudenten, der ausschließlich Aufgaben abarbeitet. Wir suchen jemanden, der mitdenkt, Verantwortung übernimmt und Dinge voranbringen möchte.

Als Founders Associate bekommst du die Möglichkeit, sehr nah an den Gründern zu arbeiten und zu erleben, wie Entscheidungen in einem wachsenden Unternehmen tatsächlich getroffen und umgesetzt werden.

Wenn du bei einem neuen Thema gerne selbst recherchierst, Lösungswege entwickelst und moderne Tools – einschließlich KI – selbstverständlich nutzt, um schneller zu guten Ergebnissen zu kommen, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

title: Consultant Infrastructure & Capital Projects (all genders)
description:
Aufgaben

Du willst an Projekten mitwirken, die die Energie- und Infrastruktur von morgen gestalten? Bei uns arbeitest du an anspruchsvollen Infrastrukturvorhaben entlang des gesamten Projektlebenszyklus – von der strategischen Planung bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung. Mit analytischem Denken, einem Gespür für Kundenbedarfe und Interesse an technologischer Transformation trägst du dazu bei, komplexe Projekte effizient, nachhaltig und zukunftsorientiert voranzubringen.

Deine Mission
Als Consultant Infrastructure & Capital Projects bist du Teil anspruchsvoller Infrastrukturprojekte. Du bringst dich schnell in Projektteams ein, übernimmst früh Verantwortung und unterstützt dabei, tragfähige Lösungen für unsere Kunden zu entwickeln und erfolgreich umzusetzen. Bei Accenture gestaltest du dein Arbeitsumfeld aktiv mit – mit Arbeitsweisen, die zu dir passen. Du bleibst flexibel und wirst Teil eines Teams voller einzigartiger Menschen, die gemeinsam etwas bewegen. Diese Position ist in Voll- und Teilzeit möglich.

Das erwartet dich

  • Treibe die Transformation von Infrastrukturprojekten voran
    Gemeinsam mit deinem Team unterstützt du Kund:innen dabei, komplexe Infrastrukturprojekte ganzheitlich zu transformieren – von der strategischen Konzeption bis zur operativen Umsetzung. Du identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale, entwickelst pragmatische Lösungsansätze und schaffst messbaren Mehrwert durch Effizienzsteigerung, Digitalisierung und moderne Projektsteuerung.
  • Übernimm Verantwortung in Infrastrukturprojekten
    Du unterstützt unsere Kund:innen bei der Steuerung anspruchsvoller Infrastrukturvorhaben und arbeitest aktiv an der Strukturierung, Priorisierung und Umsetzung zentraler Projektanforderungen mit. Dabei schaffst du Transparenz in komplexen Zusammenhängen, bereitest fundierte Entscheidungsgrundlagen vor und übernimmst früh Verantwortung für qualitativ hochwertige Ergebnisse.
  • Begleite die Umsetzung vor Ort beim Kunden
    Du begleitest Kund:innen dabei, komplexe Infrastrukturprojekte mit hoher Steuerungsqualität erfolgreich umzusetzen. Dabei unterstützt du den Aufbau wirksamer Projektstrukturen, stärkst das Stakeholder-Management und hilfst Projektteams, auch in dynamischen Umfeldern konsistent starke Ergebnisse zu liefern.

Qualifikation

Darauf freuen wir uns

  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, (Wirtschafts-)Ingenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren Fachgebiet.
  • Idealerweise konntest du bereits erste praktische Erfahrungen durch Praktika oder Werkstudententätigkeiten in der Beratung oder in Infrastrukturprojekten sammeln.
  • Du überzeugst durch eine offene, kommunikative Persönlichkeit und bewegst dich sicher im Austausch mit Kunden und Projektteams.
  • Du hast Lust, dich in neue Themen einzuarbeiten, denkst analytisch und bringst die Flexibilität mit, die ein dynamisches Beratungsumfeld erfordert.
  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch – jeweils mindestens auf C1-Niveau.

Benefits

Deine Vorteile bei Accenture

  • Ein flexibles Arbeitsmodell, bei dem du die Möglichkeit hast, mobil zu arbeiten, ein eigenverantwortliches Überstundenkonto zuführen und deine Arbeitszeit aktiv selbst zu gestalten
  • Zugriff auf umfassende Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten zu den neusten Technologie- Trends sowie Soft Skills, damit du immer up-to-date bleibst
  • Diverse sowie gleichberechtigte Teammitglieder liegen uns sehr am Herzen und um den Team-Zusammenhalt zu stärken, fördern wir regelmäßig Events und Veranstaltungen für dich und dein Team
  • Ein attraktives und marktkonformes Vergütungspaket, welches du durch individuelle Zielerreichung selbst gestalten kannst
  • Weitere Benefits, die unserer Meinung nach zum Standard gehören, aber nicht vergessen werden sollten: Mitarbeitenden-Rabatte, die Möglichkeit ein Job-Rad oder einen PkW zu Firmenkonditionen zu leasen, das Partizipieren an unserem Aktienprogramm, Versicherungs- und Altersvorsorge-Möglichkeiten und noch vieles mehr…

Die Accenture-Kultur: Hier machst DU den Unterschied

Deine Fähigkeiten, dein Naturell und deine Ambitionen machen dich einzigartig. Und wenn die unterschiedlichsten Talente, Stärken und Sichtweisen aufeinandertreffen, entsteht etwas Großartiges: Ideen, die in der Welt etwas bewegen. Deshalb setzen wir bei Accenture auf Diversität und freie Entfaltung. Schaffe dir ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem du aufgehst. Mit Aufgaben, die dir am Herzen liegen. Mit einem Workload, der zu dir passt. Und mit einer Arbeitsweise, die sich an deinen Zielen orientiert. Wie du dich vernetzen, weiterbilden und persönlich wachsen willst, liegt bei dir. Es ist deine Karriere. Wir helfen dir, sie so zu gestalten, wie du es dir vorstellst.

Dein Kontakt

Du hast Fragen? Dann wende dich gerne an Jil Felderhoff. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

title: Offre de stage de recherche Master 2 ou dernière année d’école d’ingénieur
description:
Dates : 6 mois à partir de février ou mars 2027

Contexte du projet :

L’allègement des structures automobiles reste un levier majeur pour réduire la consommation et les émissions des véhicules, tout en répondant à des exigences croissantes de rigidité et de tenue au crash. Les pièces de caisse en blanc sont en grande majorité réalisées à partir de tôles d’acier mises en forme, dont la conception repose encore largement sur l’expertise et sur des itérations successives entre calcul et dessin.

L’optimisation topologique permet de déterminer la meilleure répartition de matière dans un domaine de conception donné. Appliquée à un domaine volumique 3D, elle conduit cependant à des structures massives ou de type treillis, difficilement transposables en pièces embouties d’épaisseur quasi constante. Le défi scientifique consiste à formuler une méthode capable de faire émerger, à partir d’un domaine volumique, des géométries représentatives de tôles (structures à parois minces), en maîtrisant l’épaisseur et la fabricabilité, sous chargements statiques puis dynamiques.

Ce stage s’inscrit dans le cadre d’une collaboration de recherche entre le LTDS et ArcelorMittal Global R&D. Il a vocation à se poursuivre par une thèse CIFRE en cas de résultats concluants.

L’objectif du stage sera de développer et d’évaluer une première méthodologie d’optimisation topologique 3D aboutissant à une solution en tôle d’acier, en s’appuyant sur une structure automobile.

Les missions pourront comprendre :

•Un état de l’art des méthodes d’optimisation topologique conduisant à des structures minces de type coque (contrôle d’épaisseur par filtrage et projection, contraintes de longueur caractéristique, approches par composants explicites ou level-set).

•Le développement d’un algorithme d’optimisation 3D appliqué à une pièce automobile soumise à des chargements statiques.

•L’extension de la méthode à des solutions plus avancées proposées par ArcelorMittal.

Les missions pourront être adaptées en fonction du profil du candidat et de l’avancement du projet.


Profil recherché : étudiant(e) en Master 2 ou équivalent (stage ingénieur) dans le domaine de la mécanique numérique, du calcul des structures ou des mathématiques appliquées.

Compétences souhaitées : méthode des éléments finis, optimisation numérique, programmation scientifique (Python, MATLAB ou C++). Des connaissances en optimisation topologique ou en dynamique rapide (LS-DYNA, Radioss) seront appréciées.

Encadrement : Frédéric Gillot (LTDS, École Centrale de Lyon) ; Daoming Yu, Alexandre Blaise et Cristian Alvarez (ArcelorMittal Global R&D).

L’accueil au laboratoire est soumis à une autorisation préalable (procédure FSD, 2 à 3 mois de délai) : les candidatures (CV, lettre de motivation, relevés de notes) sont à adresser dès que possible.

title: Pre-Sales / Sales Engineer
location: Paris, France; Marseille, France; Bordeaux, France; Nantes, France; Strasbourg, France; Lyon, France
description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Pre-Sales role ⭐️

Our Pre-Sales team strengthens Alan’s Enterprise and Public sector Sales to better handle the specificities of our largest customers.

Here are the main missions of the team you will join:

  • Master our platform and support Sales team by enabling them with insights, expertise and the relevant tools;

  • Listen and understand prospects’ needs and work internally on how Alan can address them best;

  • Build a thorough understanding of the prospect and assess the level of functional alignment with our offering and capabilities;

  • Participate to RFP submissions and build Alan’s response in collaboration with Sales, Insurance and Product experts;

  • Join the customer acquisition journey to evangelize our services and products;

  • Act as voice of the customer feeding Alan’s platform roadmap;

  • Prepare handover for delightful customers’ onboardings;

  • Eventually coordinate the most complex customer onboardings leveraging your unique knowledge of the customer’s requirements and specificities.

You will actively participate in developing this growing function within Alan and edit the company to make our Sales teams the most successful of all!

Given the growing need for onsite customer engagement, you are ideally located in Paris or the Île-de-France region (or within a 2-hour door to door distance with the flexibility to travel to Paris on short notice for customer meetings).

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the D-E level range.

⭐️ You will be a great fit if ⭐️

  • You have 6+ years of experience working in a SaaS environment, including at least 3 in a Pre-Sales / Sales Engineering / Solution Consultant role.

  • You have a talent for quickly getting to the root cause of customers concern through active listening and requirements elicitation;

  • You are assertive and know how to handle objections in a complex environment;

  • You master the art of pitching a product with transparency and without overselling its capabilities ;

  • You have the ability to break down complex issues and identify product gaps to define the best product solutions;

  • You thrive at high level stakeholders’ management;

  • You excel at prioritizing tasks while living up to commitments;

  • You love teamwork and are always eager to learn and grow;

  • You are fluent in both French and English;

It would be even better if you have:

  • Experience with end-to-end procurement projects (buyer or supplier side) with involvement in RFI’s, RFQ’s and RFP’s;

  • Experience in the French Public Sector;

  • Experience in HRIS ecosystems and Payroll solutions;

  • Experience in Insurance or Health platforms.

🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our HQ, sponsored co-working hubs or a full-remote experience with home office equipment sponsorship, we want you to live where you’re the happiest.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

description:
Join our mission

We're proud to work with many incredible companies, accelerating their ability to build their products.

We've spent years watching talented engineering teams lose momentum to the same frustrating bottleneck: waiting. Waiting for CI to finish. Waiting for builds to complete. Waiting for tests to run.

After experiencing this pain firsthand at companies of every size, we set out to build the developer infrastructure platform we'd always wanted to use. Something that would seamlessly integrate with our workflows and the tools teams already love—but make everything dramatically faster and more cost-effective.

Today, we're already accelerating hundreds of companies around the world, helping them ship features instead of waiting for infrastructure. We've built something that feels almost magical in its simplicity: change your runs-on line, mount your toolchain cache directory and suddenly your builds are 5x faster.

About the role

Namespace's approach is low-friction, designed for immediate integration into existing developer toolchains, empowering teams to experience tangible results within just five minutes. With an end-to-end stack optimized for high performance—including compute, memory, storage, and networking—Namespace delivers capabilities and efficiencies unmatched by traditional cloud providers.

As a Product Engineer at Namespace, you'll develop products that significantly enhance developer productivity. You'll build intuitive, performant user-facing applications and integrations that seamlessly fit into developers' existing workflows, directly impacting their ability to ship faster and more efficiently.

Our culture

We're looking for people with grit—people who push through ambiguity, take ownership, and keep going when things get hard. You're deeply curious, driven to understand how things work and how they can be improved. title: Chief Operating Officer COO
description:
At Vio, we believe booking accommodation should feel fair and effortless, never overwhelming or unclear.

As one of the world’s fastest-growing travel tech platforms, we help millions of users make smarter travel decisions by comparing stays across 100+ booking sites so that they can find the best place, at the best price, anywhere in the world.

Our goal is to help travelers book like an insider. That means cutting through the noise and complexity of hotel booking and surfacing real value with clarity, transparency, and full support. No tricks. No confusion. Just great stays, booked with confidence.

With operations in 100+ markets and growing fast, our mission is to reshape how people discover and book accommodation through technology that travelers can trust.

Who we’re looking for

We are looking for an experienced Chief Operating Officer (COO) to join our Leadership Team and help us scale our booking operations, drive efficiency and deliver a best-in-class experience for our travelers.

Reporting to Oz , Our CEO, and joining Vio's Leadership Team, you'll be hired into the full organisation with a clear first focus: our booking (OTA) business. You'll lead Customer Support, OTA Finance, Payments and Legal, and work closely with our Product and Tech leads to optimise how we scale, simultaneously reducing our transactional and operational costs.

What you will do:

  • Scale our booking operations from ~4k bookings per day towards 20k–40k by 2028

  • Reduce our transactional and operational costs through continuous improvement, automation and smarter processes

  • Raise the quality of our user experience to match the best in the industry

  • Make sure our business operates smoothly across multiple jurisdictions

  • Support the scaling of our booking operations while limiting our risk exposure

  • Lead and develop your team: our Heads of Customer Support, OTA Finance and Payments and our Legal Counsel

Who you are:

  • A senior operations leader with experience scaling – not just operating at scale – ideally in a leadership position at a 500+ FTE organisation

  • Highly structured and analytically strong; data-fluent and comfortable making complex decisions in ambiguous situations

  • A proven track record of driving efficiency through continuous improvement, ideally in an online travel marketplace or accommodation distribution organisation

  • A pragmatic, flexible problem solver who fits operations to business needs rather than following frameworks or 'what we've done before'

  • Someone who simplifies for others, builds strong relationships and can hold critical lines

  • Experienced working in founder-led organisations and stepping into new, previously unowned areas

  • Travel industry experience is a big plus (especially flights / packages); B2C experience preferred, B2B welcome

  • Experience collaborating with enterprise partners is a real plus

Why join us now?

  • We’re one of the fastest-growing accommodation booking platforms in the world today, having grown our bookings 30x between 2017 and 2025, and catering to the needs of millions of travelers each year. We do that by harnessing the power of advanced algorithms and an innovative suite of product features.

  • In 2026, we underwent a company-wide rebrand and launched our first StoryTelling marketing campaign in the UK. This was the next step in our commitment to help travelers book like insiders, and to establish Vio as a consumer-facing, creative brand.

  • The mobile applications (iOS and Android) we launched in 2023 have been a big success, reaching 5 million installs and earning strong customer reviews.

  • We’re a passionate and diverse team of tech enthusiasts and creatives, with a commitment to the traveler above all else.

  • We reward our employees for the value they create by granting Stock Appreciation Rights to all employees.

What we offer:

  • Plenty of chances to learn and grow within an open, diverse culture that promotes knowledge sharing, trust, and transparency.

  • A great compensation package, perks, and benefits – including significant stock appreciation rights.

  • Flexible time off, with as many holidays as you need, and a chance to work remotely.

  • You’ll be part of an international team in one of the best office locations in Amsterdam

  • We value good food and offer catered lunches from various cuisines, great coffee, and the occasional barbecue in our garden.

  • We enjoy getting together to celebrate our wins, with company events in Amsterdam and abroad.

  • A budget for your home office

  • Access to free mental health support via OpenUp

We encourage people from all ethnic groups, genders, sexualities, ages, and abilities to apply. If this job description resonates with you, we’d love to hear from you.

Please note: This role is based in our Amsterdam office.

title: Talent Acquisition Partner (LATAM)
description:
Talent Acquisition Partner

Remote | Latin America | Less than 10% travel

Build the team behind our growth in Latin America

Precision for Medicine is expanding across Latin America, building the people and capabilities needed to support clinical research across key markets including Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, and Peru. Our goal is clear: build strong local teams that allow us to support clients more directly as their programs progress through the drug development lifecycle.

We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Partner who wants to help build that future.

This is more than a traditional recruiting role. You will help shape our talent strategy and employer presence across a region where Precision continues to invest and grow. You will recruit the people who will deliver clinical programs, strengthen our regional capabilities, and help us deliver on the commitments we make to our clients and, ultimately, the patients their therapies are designed to serve.

You will join an established global life sciences organization while working in a region that still offers the opportunity to build, influence, and make your mark.

What you’ll do

  • Lead full-cycle recruitment across assigned business areas, from intake and sourcing through interviews, offers, references, and onboarding handoff.
  • Partner with hiring managers and business leaders to understand their needs and turn them into focused recruiting strategies.
  • Build proactive talent pipelines for specialized and hard-to-fill roles across Latin America.
  • Identify and engage passive talent through LinkedIn, professional networks, referrals, market mapping, social channels, and creative sourcing.
  • Bring market intelligence to the conversation, including talent availability, competitor activity, compensation trends, and hiring challenges.
  • Use recruiting data and insights to identify risks, measure progress, and help leaders make better hiring decisions.
  • Create a candidate experience that is transparent, respectful, responsive, and representative of Precision.
  • Help strengthen Precision’s employer brand and talent communities across Latin America.
  • Partner with regional and global colleagues to improve recruiting processes and build scalable talent acquisition capabilities.

What you bring

  • 3+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience in a growing, technical, scientific, or specialized organization.
  • Strong sourcing skills and experience building pipelines in competitive talent markets.
  • The confidence to advise and influence hiring managers and senior leaders.
  • Strong business judgment, ownership, and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Experience using recruiting data and market insights to guide decisions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • A collaborative, curious, and candid working style.
  • Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant experience.

Experience recruiting within life sciences, clinical research, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, healthcare, or a CRO environment is preferred. Experience supporting multiple countries or regional hiring is also valuable.

Why Precision?

Latin America represents an important part of Precision’s growth strategy. The region offers experienced clinical research professionals, expanding research infrastructure, diverse patient populations, and the opportunity to strengthen our capabilities in areas where Precision has deep expertise, including oncology, rare disease, and complex clinical development.

You will help us build the teams behind that strategy.

You will have the opportunity to influence how we attract talent, build our presence, and establish Precision as an employer of choice across Latin America.

And the people you recruit will help us do something bigger: support our clients in advancing new therapies through clinical development and closer to the patients who need them.

Ready to help build what comes next?

Apply and help us grow Precision in Latin America.

title: Sr. Clinical Research Associate (Brazil)
description:
Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases. GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development.
We operate as a private, profit-with-purpose company, channeling our commercial success back into scientific research, technology, and our people. With approximately 700 people across multiple countries and three service lines, we are growing deliberately, and the capability of our leaders and our organization is central to how we get there.

If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you!

Job Overview

The Senior Clinical Research Associate (Sr. CRA) independently performs, coordinates and oversees clinical site monitoring activities, ensuring compliance with study protocols, Alimentiv and sponsor procedures, ICH-GCP guidelines and local regulatory requirements.

Serving as a primary liaison between investigative sites, Alimentiv and sponsors, the Sr. CRA plays a key role in the successful execution of clinical studies from site selection and start-up through monitoring and close-out. This role also provides guidance and mentorship to CRA I and CRA II colleagues and may participate in CRA assessment visits, co-monitoring activities, audits and inspections.

Key Responsibilities

  • Independently conduct and document onsite and remote site management activities, including site qualification, initiation, monitoring and close-out visits, in accordance with applicable SOPs and study requirements.

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for investigative sites, building effective working relationships and ensuring site questions, issues, action items and protocol deviations are followed through to resolution.

  • Review source documentation and study systems to ensure clinical data is accurate, complete and compliant with protocol, regulatory and study requirements; manage and facilitate the resolution of data queries.

  • Oversee site activation and ongoing site management activities, working with sites and cross-functional teams to achieve project timelines, milestones and recruitment objectives.

  • Ensure site personnel are appropriately trained on study protocols, plans, systems, ICH-GCP requirements and project-specific expectations.

  • Routinely review Investigator Site Files (ISF), Trial Master Files (TMF) and study systems for accuracy, completeness, timeliness and compliance, requesting outstanding documentation as required.

  • Coordinate site-related study activities and communications, including clinical supplies, investigational product, laboratory materials, ePROs, study documentation and ongoing project updates.

  • Collaborate with Study Start-up, Regulatory and other cross-functional teams, including supporting document collection, localisation and translation activities where required.

  • Participate in study meetings, Investigator Meetings, audits and inspections, supporting issue resolution and implementation of corrective actions when required.

  • Mentor and support CRA I and CRA II colleagues, including CRA Assessment Visits, co-monitoring and sign-off activities; contribute to CRA interviews, training and process improvement initiatives as requested.

Skills & Qualifications

  • (Honours) Bachelor’s degree required; a degree in Health Sciences, Life Sciences, Pharmacy or Nursing is preferred. A Master’s degree is considered an asset.

  • Minimum 4–6 years of relevant clinical research experience; 7–9 years of related experience is preferred.

  • Must have previous GI experience.

  • Experience across Phase I–IV clinical trials is preferred.

  • Thorough knowledge of ICH-GCP and applicable local regulatory requirements.

  • Demonstrated experience independently conducting site qualification, initiation, monitoring and close-out visits.

  • Proficiency with clinical trial systems including EDC platforms (e.g., Medidata Rave, Oracle InForm), IRT, eTMF and CTMS, as well as Microsoft Office.

  • Strong interpersonal, communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and effectively within cross-functional teams.

  • Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage priorities with an appropriate sense of urgency.

  • Fluent written and verbal English; an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.

  • Valid driver’s licence and ability to travel approximately 40–60%, depending on project assignment and the geographic location of investigative sites.

What We Offer

In addition, as an Alimentiv Employee, you’re also eligible for the following programs:

  • Education Reimbursement program for full-time employees
  • Monthly Cell Phone and Remote Work Allowance (dependent on role eligibility)
  • One time office setup allowance (can be used to purchase a scanner/printer, extra monitor, office furniture, etc.)
  • Working while visiting program – up to 4 weeks per year!
  • Flexible Summer Hours Program from May – September
  • Employee referral incentive – we know great people know other great people, and we think that warrants recognition!
  • Full-time employees also become beneficiaries of the Alimentiv Trust after one year of employment, and permanent members after 5 years of employment
  • Optional formal mentorship program (Alimentorship); country/region annual social events in person; leadership development programs for people leaders in accordance with your seniority; social committee and several other optional initiatives designed to support you in feeling like part of the Alimentiv team!

Additional benefits may be available depending on the country of employment and are subject to local policies and eligibility.

Our Services

  • End-to-end GI clinical trial services, from protocol design through submission support
  • Central medical imaging management and endoscopic reading
  • Precision medicine and biomarker solutions
  • Real-world evidence and clinical consulting
  • Histopathology and lab services through AcelaBio

How to Apply

To apply for this position, please submit your resume through the Alimentiv Careers Portal or via LinkedIn’s Easy Apply. Resumes must be submitted in English.

Equal Opportunity and Accessibility

Alimentiv is committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, ethnicity, national origin, religion or belief, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital or family status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Accommodations are available upon request for persons with disabilities throughout the recruitment and selection process. Requests can be directed to recruitment@alimentiv.com.

Compensation

Additional Information

Stay Alert to Recruitment Scams

Alimentiv is aware of a continued increase in phishing scams, which use various methods of attack via email, text, voice and social media, including individuals posing as our recruiters and contacting candidates with fraudulent opportunities. Our hiring process always includes direct engagement with a recruiter or hiring manager, and we will never ask for sensitive personal information early in the process.

Official communication will only come from company email addresses containing "@alimentiv.com". If you are contacted about an open job at Alimentiv, please verify the domain of the sender's email address and confirm that you are being asked to apply on this website. If something doesn't feel right, we encourage you to verify before responding. If you believe you have been the victim of a phishing scam, please contact your local government cyber authority to report it.

title: In-House CRA II (Mexico)
description:
We’re expanding across Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, Colombia, Chile and Peru, and we’re looking for an experienced In-house CRA II to help build the foundation of this new regional function in Mexico!

The In-house CRA II provides overall support to study sites and clinical project teams engaged in clinical research studies. You will adhere to applicable protocols, standard operating procedures (SOPs) and all applicable guidelines and regulatory requirements (e.g., International Council for Harmonization (ICH), Good Clinical Practice (GCP), and country/region-specific regulations). Acts as point of contact for study sites.

The In-house CRA ll is a solid team member who can execute all core responsibilities consistently across several studies using independent judgment and critical thinking. Individual works independently as study team member with minimum support in complex activities.

Essential functions of the job included but not limited to:

  • Assist with the investigator recruitment activities utilizing phone scripts, questionnaires, study site materials and other tools for use in evaluating investigative sites
  • May assist in identifying study sites by performing site feasibility and recruitment tasks, e.g., completing, disseminating, and reviewing responses to site recruitment questionnaires
  • Schedules internal and external meetings as required
  • Prepares Investigator Site Files including distribution to study sites (electronically or physically), coordination with shipping vendor, if required
  • Performs ongoing essential document collection and review, maintenance, and close-out activities, organizing and maintaining site level data in the trial master file (TMF) under general supervision ensuring that sponsor and investigator obligations are being met and are compliant with ICH/GCP guidelines and applicable local regulations
  • Assist with set ups and maintains site-related data in applicable clinical systems according to procedures and guidelines Utilizes the Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS) to ensure milestones and activities are accurately tracked
  • Acts as site contact/liaison for study and site management issues including addressing questions, assists with managing study supplies, and may support offsite central monitoring activities. Escalates issues and risks as needed
  • Ensures timely and complete data entry by site in EDC or any other system that requires data entry
  • Sends email blasts/newsletter, updates, and updated study core documents to study site personnel
  • Assists in providing logistics support in samples management and tracking, where applicable and in study supply management
  • Supports investigators and investigative staff in fulfilling obligations regarding local submissions according to local regulatory and Institution Review Board (IRB)/Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) requirements
  • Assists in data review inclusive of site level data review, resolutions provided by sites to queries, facilitates database closure and freezing procedures as per study plans
  • Assist with study tracking via the CTMS, Study specific trackers or sponsor designated system to ensure that the study reporting is current, accurate and complete
  • Documents site and Sponsor contact and study interactions in a timely and professional manner
  • Assist in remote review of the electronical Investigator Site File, where applicable
  • Assists with Investigational Product accountability, where applicable
  • Consults with project team members regarding study site issues
  • Provides quality review of the amended site level informed consent template
  • Follows up with sites for trial invoices and ensures the CTMS is accurately updated to allow the timely processing of Investigator Payments
  • May attend site visits as needed, supporting the CRA to ensure sponsor and investigator obligations related to the study documentation are being met and are compliant with applicable regulatory requirements and guidelines
  • May serve as an Independent Essential Document Reviewer post-SIV
  • Supports on-site visits activities if needed
