title: US Remote Patient Care Advocate (Customer Service)
description:
Job Title: Patient Care Advocate 

Job Location: Remote


About Us: 

We are a dedicated team focused on improving access to affordable prescription medications for patients. By partnering with insurance companies, healthcare providers, and pharmacies, we work to reduce the financial burden of medications, ensuring that patients can access the treatments they need without excessive costs. 


Role Overview: 

As a key member of our team, you will help patients navigate our Prescription Payment Plan. This involves working closely with patients, insurance providers, healthcare professionals, and pharmacies to ensure seamless enrollment, eligibility verification, cost-sharing, and prescription fulfillment. 


What You’ll Do: 

  • Patient Enrollment & Eligibility: Assist patients with enrolling in the program, ensuring all necessary personal and insurance information is provided and verifying eligibility. 
  • Prescription Coverage: Help patients confirm that their prescribed medications are covered under the program, and manage the approval process for eligible medications. 
  • Cost-Sharing & Payment: Reduce patients' out-of-pocket costs by applying the program benefits. Manage copayments, coinsurance, and assist with additional copay assistance when applicable. 
  • Prescription Fulfillment: Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount. 
  • Refills & Continued Use: Support patients by ensuring they continue receiving medications at reduced costs, monitoring adherence to medication regimens, and ensuring continued eligibility. 
  • Program Renewal & Updates: Guide patients through annual renewals and inform them about any updates to the program or medication formulary. 


What We’re Looking For: 

  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Experience in healthcare, insurance or customer service required (experience with prescription assistance programs is a plus)
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to navigate complex processes
  • Excellent communication skills for working with patients, healthcare providers, and pharmacies
  • A genuine passion for helping others and making a positive impact on their healthcare access
  • The ability to work efficiently and collaboratively within a team environment

Success Factors for Working from Home 

  • Private Workspace: A dedicated, quiet workspace with a door that closes, free from ambient noise. 
  • Ergonomics: A comfortable desk and chair setup that allows for the proper installation of necessary equipment. 
  • Reliable Internet Connection: Stable, high-speed internet with a minimum bandwidth of 10 Mbps downstream and 5 Mbps upstream. 
  • Quiet, Distraction-Free Workspace: A dedicated, quiet area where you can focus on delivering excellent customer service without interruptions. 
  • Tech-Savvy: Comfort with technology and ability to learn new systems quickly. 
  • Self-motivation & Independence: Ability to stay productive and manage your time effectively in a remote environment. 
  • Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills, especially in a virtual setting. 
  • Adaptability: Ability to adapt to changing technologies and procedures while working remotely. 


Compensation & Perks 

  • Hourly Pay: $16.50 per hour 
  • Company-Provided Equipment: All necessary equipment will be provided. 
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Full health insurance package including medical, dental, and vision coverage. 
  • Cell Phone Benefits: $25/month per line for unlimited phone, text, and data (restrictions may apply). 
  • Generous Referral Program: Earn $50 per paycheck for every person you refer—and your referral earns it too! No limits on payouts. 
  • Comprehensive Training: Paid training to ensure you are fully prepared for success. 
  • Career Growth: Opportunities for career advancement and professional development within a leading healthcare provider. 
  • Work-from-Home Convenience: Save time, and money, and reduce your environmental footprint. 
  • Inclusive Culture: We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including individuals with disabilities and veterans. 

What Success Looks Like: 

  • Reduced out-of-pocket costs for patients through effective cost-sharing and copay assistance 
  • Timely and accurate processing of prescription claims and approvals 
  • High patient satisfaction with the program’s support and streamlined experience 
  • Compliance with program requirements and monitoring of patient eligibility for ongoing assistance 

Why Join Us? 

  • Be part of a team that makes a real difference in patients' lives by reducing the cost of necessary medications 
  • Opportunity for professional growth in the healthcare and insurance sectors 
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package 
  • A collaborative, supportive, and innovative work culture 

Ready to Make an Impact? 

Join us in making prescription medications more affordable and accessible for those who need them most. If you're ready to help make a difference, we'd love to hear from you! 

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

title: Content Reviewer - United States
description:
Every search represents someone seeking reliable information. They depend on search results being accurate, trustworthy, and relevant to their local context. But search engines only learn to return trustworthy information if human evaluators with deep research expertise and cultural knowledge verify and correct them. Your linguistic precision, fact-checking rigor, and understanding of how your culture communicates and values information is irreplaceable in building search systems that people can actually trust.

 

In this role, you will evaluate search queries, results, and AI-generated content for factual accuracy, authority, relevance, and user intent alignment. Your judgment determines whether search systems return trustworthy, contextually appropriate information.

 

  • Analyze multi-turn search queries and web results for factual accuracy, source authority, and user intent alignment

Why join the project:

  • Comprehensive research support: Access detailed evaluation guidelines, reference materials, databases, and resources for fact-checking across domains
  • Quality recognition: Performance assessments focused on consistency, fact-checking precision, and nuanced judgment
  • Intellectually demanding by design: If you are driven by fact-checking precision, source authority analysis, and the challenge of identifying what makes information truly trustworthy, this work is built for that mindset.

Quartermaster is building the world's most comprehensive maritime intelligence platform. Work Environment:

title: Technical Architect
description:
Role Description

As a Technical Architect at Dropbox, you will help enterprise customers translate business goals and complex technical requirements into practical solution architectures. You will work with customers and internal teams to design how Dropbox fits into their existing systems, validate critical assumptions, and guide implementation and adoption.

You will lead architecture discussions spanning workflows, integrations, identity and access, data movement, and operational readiness. You will explain design choices and tradeoffs, identify technical risks early, and produce clear guidance that implementation teams can act on. You will also turn lessons from customer engagements into reusable patterns and actionable feedback for Product and Engineering.

Responsibilities

  • Lead technical discovery with customer business and IT stakeholders to establish requirements, constraints, dependencies, and measurable success criteria.
  • Design and document solution architectures, including system boundaries, integration and data flows, identity and permission models, and operational requirements.
  • Evaluate design options and explain tradeoffs in reliability, security, performance, implementation effort, and ongoing cost.
  • Validate high-risk assumptions through focused prototypes, integration tests, or technical evaluations with explicit acceptance criteria.
  • Guide implementation and migration planning, defining sequencing, owners, testing, cutover, rollback, and handoff to delivery and support teams.
  • Partner with Customer Success, Support, Sales, Product, and Engineering to resolve technical blockers and connect architecture decisions to customer outcomes.
  • Create reusable reference architectures, implementation guidance, and enablement materials; mentor colleagues and communicate recurring product gaps.

Requirements

  • Customer-facing technical experience: At least 3 years in technical architecture, solutions architecture, implementation consulting, or a similar role, leading discovery, solution design, demonstrations, and technical validation for enterprise SaaS customers.
  • AI experience: Experience using AI tools for technical analysis, solution design, or prototyping, including validating outputs, protecting customer data, and assessing limitations.
  • Integration expertise: Experience designing and troubleshooting API integrations, authentication, data flows, and failure handling.
  • Identity and access: Understanding of IAM and Zero Trust principles, including SSO, SAML, OAuth/OIDC, SCIM, MFA, RBAC, conditional access, and how permissions and sharing affect data exposure.
  • Implementation and migration: Experience planning implementations or migrations and coordinating dependencies, technical risks, and handoffs across teams.
  • Technical communication: Ability to write clear technical documentation, lead workshops, and explain design decisions to technical and business audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

Expertise in at least one of the following areas:

  • CASB/SSE/DLP platforms: Experience with enterprise security platforms such as Netskope, Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler, Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps, Forcepoint, Broadcom/Symantec DLP, or similar technologies.

  • Identity and access management: Experience with platforms such as Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, or Ping Identity, including managing identities, permissions, and groups and applying least-privilege access principles to SaaS applications.

  • Security ecosystems and integrations: Experience with SIEM/SOAR platforms, APIs, OAuth, event and audit logs, or security integrations, including an understanding of how SaaS and data security solutions fit into a customerâs broader security architecture.

  • Security and compliance frameworks: Experience applying frameworks or regulatory requirements such as NIST CSF, CIS Controls, ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS to address enterprise customer needs.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read thisÂ blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

Who we are

Handspring has set out to rebuild the pediatric behavioral health system from the ground up. We are a team of diverse and passionate individuals dedicated to making quality mental healthcare accessible to all young people.

Weâre hiring a full-time, remote Clinical Supervisor to join our team. This role requires active, unrestricted licensure as an LCSW in New York.

About the role

Handspring is a mission-driven, early-stage healthcare organization.

We are seeking a full-time Clinical Supervisor to join our team. As a Clinical Supervisor, you will oversee and support our team of therapists providing evidence-based CBT therapy. Your role involves providing clinical guidance, ensuring quality care, and fostering professional development among our therapists. You'll conduct individual supervision sessions, facilitate team consultations and offer risk consultations. This position offers the opportunity to shape our clinical approach and mentor therapists while improving mental health outcomes for young patients.

This is an opportunity to be a core part of a mission-driven organization that is looking to transform youth behavioral healthcare. You will work closely with Handspringâs Clinical Leadership.

What youâll do

  • Oversee and provide clinical supervision to therapists. Conduct regular individual consultation sessions to ensure high-quality care and professional development

  • Facilitate group case consultations and lead team meetings to promote collaborative problem-solving and knowledge sharing

  • Review and provide feedback on clinical documentation to maintain best practices

  • Ensure therapists' compliance with safety protocols, documentation requirements, and ethical standards

  • Provide on-call risk consultation during daytime and evening clinic hours (on a rotating basis) for complex or crisis situations

  • Mentor and support therapists in their professional growth

  • Participate in quality assurance efforts, including regular chart audits and outcome measurements

  • Collaborate with the clinical leadership team to develop and implement new evidence-based treatment approaches and programs

What weâre looking for

  • Active, unrestricted licensure as an LCSW in New York

  • Licensed mental health professional with at least 10 years post-license experience providing psychotherapy, including 6+ years specifically in pediatric mental health

  • Experience with supervision and risk management in pediatric outpatient setting

  • Ability to work independently with an interest in collaboration and learning

  • Comfort with using and learning new technologies, including Zoom, Office, electronic health record systems, and other team collaboration tools

  • Extensive knowledge of CBT. Experience with other evidence-based models, such as DBT and/or behavioral parenting support & training is a plus.

  • Experience supporting therapists in assessing and managing mild to moderate risk

  • Experience treating children, adolescents, and/or young adults with a range of diagnoses including depression, anxiety, trauma, OCD, behavioral challenges, and other diagnoses of childhood and adolescence

title: Kubernetes Administrator/Private Cloud Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Als IT-Dienstleister treiben wir die Digitalisierung des öffentlichen Sektors voran und schaffen echten Mehrwert für Millionen Menschen in Deutschland. Wir können vieles richtig gut, aber eben noch nicht alles. Darum suchen wir immer wieder neue Kolleg:innen, die mit ihren Ideen, ihrem Können und Engagement etwas bewegen wollen. Fühlst du dich angesprochen? Dann gestalte Deine Welt zum Besseren und werde Teil unseres Customer Clusters Justice.

DEINE MISSION

Als Kubernetes Administrator/Private Cloud Engineer (m/w/d) stellst du sicher, dass unsere Container-Infrastruktur reibungslos läuft und zukunftsfähig bleibt. Deine Mission ist es, eine hochverfügbare, skalierbare und sichere Plattform zu schaffen, auf der unsere Anwendungen zuverlässig betrieben und weiterentwickelt werden können. Gemeinsam mit deinem Team treibst du die Automatisierung und Optimierung unserer Cloud-Umgebung voran.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Beratung, Konzeption und Implementierung von Private Cloud Plattformen

  • Zusammenarbeit mit weiteren Fachteams zur Bereitstellung der nötigen Infrastruktur

  • Messung, Analyse und Optimierung der Performance und Stabilität

  • Aufbau und Betrieb verteilter Systeme unter Anwendung des DevOps-Ansatzes

  • Förderung von Continuous Integration & Deployment-Prozessen für eine effiziente und schnelle Bereitstellung der Lösungen

  • Fehleranalyse und -behebung in Container-Umgebungen

DAS IST UNS WICHTIG

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung im Cloud-/Plattformbetrieb

  • Erfahrung in der agilen Entwicklung und im Betrieb von verteilten Systemen

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Kubernetes und Ansible sind unerlässlich

  • Erfahrung in der Fehleranalyse und -behebung in Container-Umgebungen

  • Erfahrung in Konfiguration und Betrieb sowie in der Entstörung von Proxies

  • Ein tiefes Verständnis für DevOps-Praktiken ist von Vorteil

  • Erfahrungen mit CI/CD-Pipelines OpenShift und mit JavaEE sind ein Plus

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1-Niveau) sowie Englischkenntnisse auf Konversationsniveau

DEIN NEUER ARBEITSPLATZ

  • Was bei uns zählt? Klar definierte Rollen, echtes Miteinander und ein gemeinsames Ziel. Wir nennen das Responsiveness – transparent, wertschätzend und zielorientiert.

  • Hier bist du am Wandel direkt beteiligt, wenn du möchtest. – Nimm Teil an Projekten, die uns als Unternehmen weiterentwickeln.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Remote Work? – Sind selbstverständlich.

  • Individuelles Hardware-Budget? – Stell dir deinen Arbeitsplatz so zusammen, wie du dich am wohlsten fühlst.

  • Mental Health? – Dein mentales Wohlbefinden ist uns wichtig. Mit OpenUp unterstützen wir dich und bieten dir jederzeit kostenlosen Zugang zu professioneller psychologischer Unterstützung.

  • Individuelles Weiterbildungsbudget? – Egal ob die nächste Zertifizierung oder ein lang ersehnter Sprachkurs – du entscheidest, worin und wann du dich weiterbildest.

  • Mitarbeiter:innen-PC-Programm? – Lease dir dein nächstes Device zur rein privaten Nutzung einfach über virtual7.

  • JobRad oder Firmenwagen? – Wir helfen dir dabei, so mobil zu sein, wie du es brauchst

Ishan De

- Du bist täglich auf Instagram und TikTok unterwegs und siehst Trends, bevor sie im Feed aller anderen ankommen

- Du arbeitest selbstverständlich mit KI-Tools und probierst eigenständig neue aus

- Technisches Verständnis: Du findest dich in neuen Tools allein zurecht

- Du kannst mit Kalorien und Makros sicher rechnen

- Du kochst gern und viel, Ernährung ist deine Leidenschaft

Erfahrung in Fotografie oder mit Foodvideos

title: Anwendungsspezialist im Außendienst Baden-Württemberg (m/w/d)
description:
Wir sind der kompetente Problemlöser und zuverlässige Partner für erst klassige und effiziente Reinigungslösungen für professionelle Anwender. Rund 120 Spezialisten unter einem Dach entwickeln, produzieren und vertreiben Reinigungs- und Pflegeprodukte. Am Standort Memmingen werden alle Buzil- und Planta-Produkte hergestellt, gelagert und kommissioniert. Unsere Produkte werden vor allem in der professionellen Gebäudereinigung geschätzt. Auch in der Industrie, der Hotellerie und Gastronomie sowie in Alten- und Pflegeeinrichtungen werden sie verwendet. Im Geschäftsfeld Private Label entwickeln und produzieren wir Produkte für in dividuelle Kundenwünsche, von der ersten Idee bis zum fertigen Produkt. Neben einer Tochtergesellschaft in Polen und einer Niederlassung in den Vereinigten Arabischen Emiraten verfügen wir über Verkaufsbüros in den Balkanstaaten. Das Unternehmen wurde 1907 von Julius Wagner gegründet und ist seitdem im Familienbesitz.

Ihre Aufgaben:

  • Anwendungstechnische Beratung und Unterstützung unserer Kunden und Vertriebsmitarbeiter vor Ort
  • Planung und Durchführung regelmäßiger Schulungen für Kunden und Buzil-Außendienstmitarbeiter
  • Durchführung von Kundenseminaren vor Ort und in Memmingen
  • Mitwirkung bei der Planung und Organisation von Veranstaltungen und Seminaren
  • Eigenständige Implementierung der Buzil-Programme so wie Bearbeitung von Reklamationen beim Kunden vor Ort

Ihr Profil:

  • Als Basis verfügen Sie über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Gebäudereinigergeselle (m/w/d) oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Mehrjährige und nachweislich erfolgreiche Erfahrung in der Anwendungstechnik professioneller Reinigungstechnik-Produkte, idealerweise in der Gebäudereinigung
  • Technisches Verständnis, überzeugendes, sicheres und positives Auftreten zeichnen Sie hierbei aus
  • Hohes Engagement und Eigenmotivation sind Ihr innerer Antrieb zum Erfolg
  • Sie sind präsentationssicher, arbeiten selbstständig und organisieren Ihre Aufgaben eigenverantwortlich
  • Sie verfügen über Flexibilität und einen ausgeprägten Teamgeist
  • Sichere Kenntnisse in Englisch, Wort und Schrift, runden Ihr Profil ab
  • Ihr Wohnort sollte in der Region Stuttgart, Karlsruhe oder Heilbronn liegen


Wir bieten Ihnen:

  • Das zukünftige Gehalt wird im 1. Vorstellungsgespräch erörtert
  • Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege

title: Founder's Associate Intern (M&A & VentureDev Focus) @ T1 VC-backed Mobility Stealth Start-up from Sep/Oct '26
description:
We’re a stealth, Tier-1 VC-backed seed-stage mobility start-up that’s rewriting how vehicle inspection centers are built and operated.

With a proven expansion blueprint and a clear M&A strategy, we’ll triple revenue next year. Currently, in 4 states across Germany we have 14 Centers and 75+ colleagues.

Our founders - serial entrepreneurs who’ve raised >USD 80m from top-tier US investors and just closed another strong Seed round - are pushing hard into new geographies.

Now we need top 0.1% builders. Generalists who get energy from executing. If that sounds like you - read on.

Tasks

You’ll be the versatile generalist we need. Drive cross-functional value creation in M&A, venture/business development, data analytics, automation, finance, sales, ops, fundraising. This position requires a fast learner who is smart, hungry, and humble. Are you in?

No two weeks will look the same. One day you’ll recruit and onboard a new ops team at a rollout site, the next you’ll build a automation deployed accross all locations.

Requirements

You’re a generalist who can connect dots others don’t even see. You thrive on chaos, love fast learning curves, and deliver quality under pressure.

  • A true generalist who connects the dots across functions.
  • Experienced in fast‑paced environments (hypergrowth start‑ups, VC, growth equity, PE, investment banking, or strategy consulting) and capable of delivering high‑quality outcomes.
  • An excellent multitasker with strong organisational skills and adaptability to shifting priorities.
  • A proactive communicator and team player with a service mindset and high integrity.
  • Passionate about entrepreneurship and the start-up ecosystem with a genuine hunger to learn, grow and build a massive ops-heavy company.
  • Currently completing a bachelor's (4th semester and above) or master’s programme (business-related field is a plus) from a top-tier university.
  • Fully fluent in German is a must (C2).

Benefits

Our Offer: Small HQ team, high intensity, and big outcomes. You’ll move fast and work directly with founders who trust you to deliver.

  • Huge End-to-End Ownership: Make a real impact from day one across functions. Shape a fast-scaling platform at its inception.
  • Accelerated Career Growth: Gain first‑hand exposure in a scaling a high-growth, ops-heavy start-up – a solid launchpad for future leadership or founding roles. Experience a small core team with flat hierarchies and direct decision paths.
  • Prime Location: Work from our central Berlin Mitte office or our Nuremberg office located in the city's leading start-up incubator.
  • High-Intensity Start-up Experience: Our non‑remote culture runs from 8:30am - Check-out at 8pm. Bias for action in a revenue-driven start-up that has substantial traction and is profitable at the core.
  • Top‑Notch Product: Our product delivers - with NPS scores >90 (B2B and B2C) and Google ratings consistently between 4.8 and 5.0 stars.
  • Strong Compensation: 2.3k/month (3 months) & 2.6k/month (> 4 months); corporate fitness (Wellpass).

Sounds like you? Let’s chat.

Hiring Process:

  • Intro Chat: 30-minute call Sebastian (Chief of Staf) to align on goals and context.
  • Case Study: Take-home case study (~4-6 hours).
  • Offer

All within one week. We move fast - you should too.

title: Propulsion Data & Modeling Engineer
description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.

The heart of a spacecraft lies in its propulsion system, and that's why we, at The Exploration Company, are dedicated to developing our own cutting-edge Propulsion Systems ensuring the highest level of efficiency and reliability in our space endeavours.

We want you as a talented Propulsion Functional Systems Engineer to contribute to the development, testing, analysis, prediction and refinement of the functional architecture for Nyx Earth Propulsion System Development Models.

In order to derisk and gain confidence on the flight propulsion system, different development models are being built in order to run a multitude of tests spanning from functional tests, cold flows to system level hot fires. This testing will allow for the verification and validation of all the propulsion subsystems. You will be responsible for bridging the gap between design and hardware testing for the Nyx spacecraft propulsion system. As such, you will work closely with both the design and testing teams to ensure seamless integration and validation of propulsion subsystems.

You will report to the Propulsion Development Models Principal Engineer.

Key responsibilities:

In your capacity as a Propulsion Functional Systems Engineer, you will be responsible for the development of analysis, post processing, and prediction tools that can support testing and design activities linked to the propulsion sub-systems.

Your role will be continuously evolving, but day-to-day responsibilities will include:

During the Design Phase:

  • Work closely with the pressure and feed system engineers to define the best configuration of the test setups, ensuring a high level of representativeness and testability to conduct all fluid modelling and analyses to verify repeatability of the test rigs with the flight systems and to perform test predictions.

  • Support on the creation of test plans for propulsion subsystems (from a modeling perspective), including data acquisition, analysis, and reporting to ensure the performance of the system can be assessed.

  • Design and develop propulsion analysis and post processing tools, to support testing activities and design maturation

  • Work in close collaboration with the pressure and feed system engineers to ensure the anchoring of the different fluidic models and assess against test data

During testing phase:

  • Provide on-site support during propulsion test campaigns, working closely with the test operator and test conductor.

  • Perform test campaigns, analysing in real-time, through different test parameters and ensure test results with timely resolution of any anomaly arising during testing.

  • Conduct pre-test and post-test reviews and elaborate the test reports.

  • Update and correlate the fluidic models based on test results.

  • Provide actionable insights to identify key performance indicators and potential critical scenarios

What we would love to see from you:

  • A minimum of a bachelor's degree in a related Engineering discipline.

  • +3 years of related experience in complex fluid systems, fluidic modeling, data analysis and data post processing.

  • Strong engineering fundamentals in thermodynamics, fluid dynamics, and combustion principles.

  • Familiarity with test facilities, or storable propulsion systems is an asset

  • Experience in propulsion systems storable or cryogenic fluidic systems is a plus.

  • Proficiency in python for fluid analyses, data post processing and model anchoring.

  • Experience in EcosimPro (or similar software) for the high fidelity analysis of numerical twins.

  • Proficiency in conducting fluid analyses using classical hand calculations

  • Excellent collaboration skills for working effectively across multidisciplinary teams.

  • Fluency in English.

Skills and Behaviours:

  • Strong oral and written communication skills.

  • Strong analysis and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong organizing and prioritization of tasks.

  • Strong team player with a proactive mindset.

  • Positive and flexible attitude to get the job done.

  • Ability to communicate at all levels of the business.

  • Demonstrates behaviours consistent with The Exploration Company’s core values of Mission, Vision, Integrity, Excellence and Teamwork.

  • Space enthusiast, ready to change the European space industry.

  • Nice to have, Ecosim experience

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly.

title: Simulation Engineer - Drone Physical Models Integration
description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As our GNC, ML, Embedded Software, and Validation teams scale, they rely increasingly on simulation to develop and test our autonomous defense systems. The value of that simulation depends directly on how faithfully it reproduces the real behavior of our drones.

Joining the Tooling team, you will be responsible for bringing the physical models of our drones into the simulator—including aerodynamics, propulsion, electronics, sensors, and electromechanical systems. Designed by expert domain teams, these models require your expertise to translate user needs, integrate models into the simulator software stack, and validate expected behavior. Because not every use case requires the same level of realism, you will help establish the appropriate fidelity targets across applications.

This role offers high ownership and the opportunity to work at the intersection of physics, software engineering, and AI robotics with direct mission impact.

Responsibilities

  • Coordination with Domain Experts: Work with the teams in charge of aerodynamics, propulsion, electronics, sensors, and electromechanical systems to understand their models, their assumptions, and their inputs and outputs, and to agree on how they are delivered to the simulator.

  • Model Integration: Integrate these models into the simulator software stack in a clean, performant, and maintainable way, with clear interfaces and configurable parameters.

  • Validation: Define and run tests that check the integrated models against the reference data given by the expert teams (flight logs, bench tests, manufacturer data), and report discrepancies back to the model owners.

  • User Needs & Fidelity Targets: Work with the simulator users (GNC, Embedded, Validation) to understand their use cases, and translate them into a realism target for each model. Pick the right balance between fidelity, performance, and integration effort, and prioritise the model integration work to match.

  • Documentation & Standards: Document the integrated models, their parameters, validity domains, and validation results, and help standardise the model integration and validation process.

Candidate requirements

  • Experience: Minimum of 3 years of professional experience in software engineering, simulation, or a related engineering field.

  • Physics Understanding: Good understanding of flight dynamics and enough physics background to discuss models with experts in aerodynamics, propulsion, electronics, sensors, and electromechanical systems, and to turn their models into working code.

  • Integration & Validation: Experience integrating third-party models or components into a larger software system, and validating them against experimental data with a rigorous approach.

  • Technical Proficiency: Comfortable with C++ and Python, with a good knowledge of Linux environments.

  • Educational Background: MSc or BSc in Aerospace Engineering, Robotics, Computer Science, Applied Physics, or a similar technical field; equivalent professional experience is equally valued.

Plus (nice to have)

  • Experience with drones or robotic systems, ideally with open-source autopilots like PX4 or ArduPilot.

  • Hands-on experience with flight testing, test benches, or log analysis.

  • French language skills.

Mindset

  • Rigor: Empirical and disciplined about validation, grounded in real test data, and skeptical of a result that only exists in simulation.

  • Communication: Clear written and verbal communication, comfortable working with several specialized teams, asking the right questions, and sharing validation results with them.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

This role blends hands-on problem-solving with strategic consulting—you'll lead complex maintenance projects, troubleshoot multi-component systems, and help customers achieve optimal performance. What will you do? Diagnose and resolve complex system issues using root cause analysis and collaboration with engineering experts Oversee installation, commissioning, and preventive maintenance to ensure system reliability and safety Deliver technical consulting to customers and internal teams to uncover needs and support business development Guide field service engineers and coordinate across teams to provide seamless, high-quality service solutions What are the key skills we are looking for? Active Listening — advanced level; understanding customer concerns and translating them into technical solutions Customer Support — advanced level; delivering proactive service that builds trust and long-term relationships Maintenance and Repair — advanced level; executing complex maintenance to maximize system reliability Predictive Maintenance — advanced level; using data and diagnostics to prevent failures before they occur Problem Solving — advanced level; diagnosing root causes in multi-component systems under pressure Resilience — advanced level; maintaining focus and performance in high-stakes service environments Safety Standards — advanced level; ensuring all work meets regulatory and safety compliance requirements Technical Documentation — advanced level; creating clear records that support knowledge transfer and compliance What qualifications will make you successful? Strong collaboration skills to work across functions and drive solutions in a technical ecosystem Ability to explain complex technical information clearly to diverse audiences with confidence Proactive approach that anticipates challenges and identifies opportunities before they're asked for Comfort juggling multiple priorities while upholding quality, safety, and compliance standards What's in it for me? Meaningful work where your technical skills directly enhance customer outcomes and drive growth Opportunities to mentor team members and grow your leadership presence Exposure to advanced systems and innovative technologies across varied industries Collaborative culture that prioritizes safety, expertise, and professional development Bring your technical talent to a team that values what you do—apply today! Rewards designed for you Our Total Rewards is our way of saying: We see you and we value you. It’s more than just pay and benefits—it’s a meaningful investment in you. It is designed to help you perform, grow, feel safe, and elevate your potential. The package helps you care for yourself and your family, plan your future, grow your skills and career, collaborate in an inclusive workplace, and contribute to your community. At Schneider Electric, we’re here for what matters most to you. Discover more at our Career Page. * Country-specific programs and initiatives may be available. At Schneider Electric, our values and behaviors are the foundation for creating a great culture to support business success. We believe that our IMPACT values – Inclusion, Mastery, Purpose, Action, Curiosity, Teamwork – starts with us. IMPACT is also your invitation to join Schneider Electric where you can contribute to turning sustainability ambition into actions, no matter what role you play. It is a call to connect your career with the ambition of achieving a more resilient, efficient, and sustainable world. We are looking for IMPACT Makers; exceptional people who turn sustainability ambitions into actions at the intersection of automation, electrification, and digitization. We believe our differences make us stronger as a company and as individuals and we are committed to championing inclusivity in everything we do. Our Trust Charter is our Code of Conduct and demonstrates our commitment to ethics, safety, sustainability, quality and cybersecurity, underpinning every aspect of our business and our willingness to behave and respond respectfully and in good faith to all our stakeholders. description:
Job Title: Talent Support Specialist

Job Type: Full-time

Location: Remote

Job Summary:

Join micro1 as a Talent Support Specialist and serve as a primary point of contact for incoming and onboarded experts.

You’ll support experts throughout onboarding and beyond, manage support requests and ticketing queues, resolve blockers, and help keep day-to-day Talent Operations running smoothly.

Key Responsibilities:

title: HR Specialist
description:
About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced and highly organised HR & Recruitment Specialist to oversee recruitment, onboarding and day-to-day HR operations.

The ideal candidate will have strong people-management skills, excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage employee processes while ensuring that documentation, credentials and compliance requirements are kept up to date.

This role is suited to someone who can work independently, communicate confidently and help build efficient HR processes as the organisation grows.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the full recruitment process, including job postings, application reviews, candidate screening and interviews.
  • Coordinate hiring needs with management to ensure staffing requirements are met.
  • Oversee employee onboarding, including paperwork, background checks, credential verification and compliance.
  • Maintain accurate and confidential employee records and personnel files.
  • Track employee licenses, certifications, credentials and renewal deadlines.
  • Coordinate staff training and monitor mandatory training requirements.
  • Manage day-to-day HR queries, employee documentation and administrative tasks.
  • Support management with performance concerns, attendance issues and employee accountability.
  • Develop and improve HR processes as the organisation grows.
  • Help ensure compliance with employment regulations and healthcare staffing requirements.

Requirements

  • At least 2 years of experience in HR, recruitment, HR operations or a related field.
  • Previous supervisory or HR leadership experience.
  • Experience managing recruitment, onboarding and employee documentation.
  • Familiarity with background checks, credentialing, compliance and training requirements.
  • Experience in healthcare, behavioural health or a service-based organisation is highly preferred.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently.
  • Comfortable handling confidential and sensitive employee matters.
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace, applicant tracking systems (ATS) and HR management software.

Ideal Candidate

We’re looking for someone who is smart, proactive, highly detail-oriented and confident when dealing with people. The successful candidate should be able to take ownership of HR processes, communicate professionally, maintain confidentiality and hold employees accountable.

Healthcare or behavioural health HR experience will be a strong advantage.

title: Bilingual (French/English) Client Program Specialist
description:
About Channel Fusion

Founded more than 20 years ago, Channel Fusion provides brands and their channel partners with an ecosystem of channel marketing technologies, solutions and services. By coupling innovative technologies, industry expertise and a relentless customer-focused support team, we provide a unique combination of platforms, products and people.

Our purpose is simple: inspire our clients to achieve their desired outcomes by transforming channel marketing into impactful business results. We do this by ensuring an understanding of your desired outcomes first and then deploying tailored solutions using a disciplined process to achieve those outcomes.

Once a program is operational, our support team of Fusers becomes an extension of your brand to ensure your channel partners have an optimal customer experience while maximizing their marketing investment in your brand. Our account leadership teams stay involved every step of the way to ensure programs continue to exceed expectations and drive your desired outcomes.

About the Role

Channel Fusion is building and growing the infrastructure that powers co-op marketing programs for enterprise brands and their dealer networks. As a Bilingual Client Program Specialist, you will be the front-line partner for French and English-speaking clients by helping dealers optimize their marketing investments, navigate program guidelines, and trust that their claims and preapprovals are handled with accuracy and care.

This is a role for someone who takes pride in both the quality of their client relationships and the precision of their operational work. You'll be measured on claims accuracy and processing speed against SLA. AI tools are part of how you'll hit those numbers. This is a role where the numbers are visible and matter.

Ownership & Scope

You Own

You Do NOT Own

  • French/English client communication and relationship continuity
  • Day-to-day dealer support across inbound and outbound channels
  • Claims processing and preapproval decisions within program guidelines
  • Review of French-language marketing materials for brand and program compliance
  • Co-op budget optimization guidance for dealer partners
  • Dealer training and portal navigation coaching
  • Accuracy and efficiency metrics on your case load
  • Payment support coordination with the internal finance team and vendors (reissues, cancellations, payment tracking)
  • Program rule design or client contract terms are owned by Client Program Leads
  • Technical platform issues or site defects are owned by Engineering/IT
  • Marketing strategy for dealers: you advise on compliance.
  • Final escalation authority on disputed claims is owned by Client Program Leads

What You'll Do

Claims & Preapproval Processing

  • Claims & Preapproval Review: apply each client's specific program guidelines to review claims and preapproval requests. In co-op programs, the claim submission is the marketing material; reviewing it for brand and program compliance is the mechanism by which the claim decision gets made.
  • Process claims and preapprovals within defined SLA timeframes.
  • Maintain accuracy and processing efficiency as core performance metrics; this role is measured quantitatively as well as qualitatively.

Customer & Dealer Support

  • Provide direct customer support across phone, email, and chat for client programs, handling inbound questions and issues as they arrive.
  • Follow documented company standards and procedures for support interactions, by channel.
  • Complete tickets and follow-ups within defined SLA timeframes.
  • Coordinate with internal finance team and vendors to track down payment details and set up reissues and cancellations, and be prepared to walk the customer through the process.

Knowledge & Dealer Enablement

  • Continuously expand your knowledge of co-op marketing practices, industry trends, and compliance requirements. This is an ongoing professional development expectation.
  • Train and coach dealers and agencies to navigate and execute co-op activities through online portals.

Culture & Continuous Improvement

  • Role model a customer-centric, collaborative culture, reinforcing team values through behavior.
  • Notice and contribute to operational efficiency improvements in processes, beyond your own casework.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bilingual fluency in French and English (speaking, reading, and writing), required for dealer communication and French language material review.
  • Comfortable making judgment calls on claim compliance against written program guidelines, and explaining that judgment to a dealer who disagrees with it.
  • Strong relationship-building skills and a customer-first orientation.

Preferred

  • 2+ years of experience in a client-facing, program administration, or operations role — B2B experience a plus.
  • Proficiency in data analysis, reporting, or marketing analytics tools.
  • Knowledge of co-op marketing programs, guidelines, and compliance requirements.
  • Comfort using AI tools to improve productivity and communication workflows.

title: Video Creator (100% remote)
location: USA, Canada, Ireland and UK ONLY
description:
Make videos about brands you love and get paid, no followers required!

We're Marker Video, and we'd love for you to join our platform!👋

Sign up (it's free) and create videos about brands you love across beauty, food & drink, lifestyle, fitness, and travel.

Brands actively buying videos from their real customers (that's you) on Marker include: HelloFresh, Ollie Pets, Camile Thai, Spencer's Gifts and lots more. 

Create videos in your own tone of voice and style with no briefs or scripts from the brands. Authenticity and videos filled with your unique perspective are what brands need and want.

Videos can be reviews, tutorials, first impressions, unboxing videos, vlogs, etc. Just keep them to 30 seconds or less! 

Once your video has been uploaded to Marker, we'll notify the brand, and they can buy and use it for their marketing. 

You’ll get paid $100 for each video you successfully sell, and you can submit as many videos as you like (the more you upload, the more you can earn). 

To sign up, ensure you are: 

  • Based only in the USA, Canada, Ireland or the UK (although you submit videos remotely, we are only Stripe-enabled in select territories, so if you sign up from elsewhere, we won't be able to verify or pay you).

  • Comfortable in front of the camera

  • Fluent in spoken & written English

  • A strong, confident storyteller 

  • Competent in recording, editing and uploading videos for socials 

  • Seriously interested in TikTok & Instagram

  • Passionate about brands and products, and the content on their social channels 

Note that this is not a full-time role. Upload videos as and when you choose, and you’ll be paid for each video you sell on Marker.

Please register via the provided link ONLY; note that any applicants who email us to apply will not be registered on our system.

We can’t wait to hear from you! 
Team Marker
